sk.overview: The enterprise data, analytics and AI (DAAI) services market covers third-party spend on DAAI strategy, data foundation, AAI foundation and AAI adoption. It is being reshaped by Gen AI (post-ChatGPT) and emerging agentic AI, driving demand for AI/Gen AI consulting, model development, data modernization and governance. Industry data is sourced from the commissioned Everest Report (January 2026).
sk.structure: Enterprises meet DAAI needs via in-house teams or third-party providers; third-party share rising (40.3% of digital services in FY25). DAAI value chain split FY25: DAAI strategy 15.4%, data foundation 42.3%, AAI foundation 24.9%, AAI adoption 17.3%. BFSI/HLS/retail/CPG/TMT = ~80% of global DAAI …
